sentiment.rationale: Management raised March quarter revenue guidance to 13%-16% year-over-year growth, above the prior quarter's 16% growth rate, and gross margin guidance of 48%-49% is above the high end of the prior quarter's guidance range. The strong iPhone cycle and services momentum are organic, not attributed to one-time items. However, management explicitly flagged supply constraints on advanced nodes and rising memory costs as headwinds, which tempers the score from a higher positive.

summary.revenue: $143.8 billion, up 16% year over year, an all-time quarterly high.
summary.eps: $2.84, up 19% year over year, an all-time record.
summary.guidance: March quarter revenue expected to grow 13%-16% year over year; gross margin expected between 48%-49%; services revenue growth rate similar to December quarter.
summary.margin: Company gross margin 48.2%, up 100 basis points sequentially; products gross margin 40.7%, up 450 basis points sequentially; services gross margin 76.5%, up 120 basis points sequentially.
key_risks: Supply constraints on advanced nodes (3nm) for SoCs, making it difficult to predict when supply and demand will balance.
Growing memory component costs expected to have a bit more impact on Q2 gross margin.
Wearables, home, and accessories revenue declined 2% year over year due to AirPods Pro 3 supply constraints.
Operating expenses rose 19% year over year, primarily from increased R&D.
key_opportunities: Strong iPhone 17 cycle with 23% revenue growth and all-time records across every geographic segment.
Services all-time revenue record of $30 billion, up 14% year over year, with broad-based double-digit growth.
Installed base surpassed 2.5 billion active devices, an all-time high.
Emerging market growth, particularly India with all-time revenue records in iPhone, Mac, iPad, and services.
Collaboration with Google to develop next-generation Apple foundation models for more personalized Siri.
Apple Intelligence feature expansion driving user engagement.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO Tim Cook stated, 'I am proud to say that we just had a quarter for the record books,' and 'I have every confidence that our best work is yet to come,' reflecting strong confidence in the business trajectory.

evidence.claim: March quarter revenue guidance is 13%-16% year-over-year growth.

evidence.claim: Installed base surpassed 2.5 billion active devices.

evidence.claim: India saw all-time revenue records in iPhone, Mac, iPad, and services.
evidence.quote: We set a quarterly revenue record during December. And to go a little further down, we set quarterly revenue records on iPhone and Mac and iPad. And an all-time revenue record on services.

evidence.claim: Collaboration with Google to develop next-generation Apple foundation models.
evidence.quote: Building on our efforts in the AI space, we are also collaborating with Google to develop the next generation of Apple foundation models.

review_flags.reason: The guidance raise is explicit, but the supply constraint and memory cost headwinds are also explicitly stated. The score of 0.30 reflects a balance; a reviewer may consider whether the headwinds warrant a lower score or the guidance raise a higher one.
